bugs.error_message: Auxiliary menu export regeneration script failed with 'Nullish coalescing operator(??) requires parens when mixing with logical operators'
bugs.root_cause: The one-off Node regeneration script mixed ?? and || in the fallback expression used while rebuilding the derived menu JSON exports.
bugs.fix: Wrapped the nullish-coalescing expression in parentheses and reran the export generation command successfully.

bugs.error_message: npm run lint fails with repo-wide no-undef and no-empty errors outside the menu files
bugs.root_cause: The repository lint baseline includes non-app files that do not declare the required runtime globals or are not excluded from the shared ESLint run.
bugs.fix: Not addressed in this menu task; validated the menu rewrite with a successful production build instead.

bugs.error_message: Next build failed because src/app/_components/ui/Button.tsx differed from src/app/_components/ui/button.tsx only by casing
bugs.root_cause: A new lowercase shadcn-style button component collided with the existing uppercase UI Button path on Windows/TypeScript case-insensitive resolution.
bugs.fix: Moved the new QR-menu-specific button to src/app/masa/MasaButton.tsx and deleted the lowercase shared ui/button.tsx file.

bugs.error_message: Focused ESLint failed on generate-masa-qr-urls.mjs globals and MasaClient decorative img usage
bugs.root_cause: The script lacked declared Node/browser globals for the repo ESLint config, and the client used raw img tags that triggered the Next.js no-img-element rule.
bugs.fix: Declared script globals and switched decorative menu images to next/image.

bugs.error_message: GET /masa?id=3&key=... returned 404 during local smoke testing
bugs.root_cause: The next-intl middleware handled the unlocalized /masa route as a normal localized public page before Next could render the root /masa route.
bugs.fix: Bypassed next-intl middleware for /masa and /masa/* while preserving x-request-id headers.

bugs.error_message: POST /api/session/start returned 503 with 'Session service unavailable' during live local smoke testing
bugs.root_cause: The local environment did not define QR_MENU_SECRET, Google Sheets credentials, or TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID, so the Sheets-backed session service could not create a session.
bugs.fix: No code change; local live testing must be retried after configuring QR_MENU_SECRET, Google Sheets env vars, TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID, and the sessions sheet.

bugs.error_message: Local LAN /masa test still showed the Bulgarian WiFi overlay
bugs.root_cause: The client blocked before calling /api/session/start when the QR key was missing, and /api/session/start still required Sheets-backed sessions even for trusted local test hosts.
bugs.fix: Added a development-only local session bypass for localhost, Ethernet, and Tailscale hosts, and updated the client to allow missing QR keys only on those local test hosts.

bugs.error_message: User reported /masa used a new design instead of the existing design and pointed to the word 'всекидневник'
bugs.root_cause: The QR menu implementation created a new Tailwind newspaper-inspired layout instead of reusing the established /[locale]/table 'Всекидневник' design.
bugs.fix: Replaced the /masa renderer with the existing newspaper masthead/article/button structure and reused table.module.scss while preserving /masa session, heartbeat, language, and waiter-call logic.

bugs.error_message: User clarified not to change fonts/layout; only photo layout and hamburger menu controls should change
bugs.root_cause: The reference-image implementation changed the visible masthead typography and menu-item layout instead of limiting changes to images and drawer navigation.
bugs.fix: Restored the existing Всекидневник masthead/list rendering and kept only the hamburger drawer plus dish photo strip/clipping changes.

bugs.error_message: ParserError: An empty pipe element is not allowed.
bugs.root_cause: The first SVG copy/check command attempted to pipe directly from a foreach statement block, which PowerShell parsed as an empty pipeline element.
bugs.fix: Reran the command by assigning foreach results to a variable before piping to Format-Table, then copied the SVG successfully.

bugs.error_message: Playwright strict mode violation: locator('main') resolved to 2 elements
bugs.root_cause: The page contains nested main landmarks, so the generic snapshot target `main` was ambiguous in Playwright strict mode.
bugs.fix: Used a direct DOM evaluation for the specific masthead logo instead of relying on an ambiguous `main` locator.

bugs.error_message: User reported the /masa logo still needed improvement after the first enlargement/color filter pass
bugs.root_cause: The logo still used its original bright SVG palette and relied on CSS filtering, which left it visually separate from the newspaper theme.
bugs.fix: Replaced the SVG fill colors with the paper/ink/accent theme palette and increased the masthead logo size while keeping the text header removed.

bugs.error_message: User said the /masa logo should look carved into newspaper, use wood brown instead of red, and be smaller
bugs.root_cause: The previous logo treatment was still too large, visibly red-accented, and read like a sticker/badge instead of an embedded newspaper mark.
bugs.fix: Cropped and reduced the stamp wrapper, muted the embossed blend/filtering, and replaced red SVG accents with wood-brown colors.

bugs.error_message: User reported duplicate text in the /masa design while asking to remove the digital menu label
bugs.root_cause: The category description was rendered twice: once as the deck paragraph and again as the lede paragraph with drop cap.
bugs.fix: Removed the digital menu label and deleted the repeated lede rendering so each category description appears only once.

bugs.error_message: User reported that card images should be related to the current category items, e.g. salads should show only salads
bugs.root_cause: The card strip selected neighboring categories around the active category, so hot beverages could show beer/salad cards and other unrelated category photos.
bugs.fix: Replaced neighboring-category selection with active-category image pools and created a photo capture backlog for categories/items without card images.

bugs.error_message: User reported untranslated text in the table hamburger menu, header, and menu categories
bugs.root_cause: The QR table masthead still hardcoded Bulgarian labels, and the public menu JSON fell back to Bulgarian for category titles/descriptions in the en/tr locales.
bugs.fix: Localized the masthead labels in MasaClient and filled the en/tr category titles and descriptions in the QR menu JSON.

bugs.error_message: User reported the three hero-strip images were still static dish photos instead of restaurant indoor/outdoor images
bugs.root_cause: The shared heroImages array still pointed at menu food assets, so the QR/table masthead reused dish images in the slider strip.
bugs.fix: Replaced the hero strip sources with indoor and outdoor restaurant photos.

bugs.error_message: User reported the image card names were not translated
bugs.root_cause: Category image cards stored hardcoded Bulgarian strings and the QR menu rendered them directly without locale-aware lookup.
bugs.fix: Converted card titles/notes to localized bg/tr/en objects and rendered them through the existing locale helper.

bugs.error_message: User requested the footer to add a 'Powered by Melih Hyusein' link
bugs.root_cause: The QR/table footer only rendered the newspaper colophon and had no creator credit link.
bugs.fix: Added an external footer credit link to https://portfolio.melihzafer.me and styled it to match the existing footer.

bugs.error_message: User reported some card text overflowed
bugs.root_cause: The translated card titles and notes became longer, but the card typography and min-heights were tuned for short Bulgarian labels.
bugs.fix: Reduced card-title and note font sizes, increased header/note vertical space, and enabled safe wrapping and hyphenation.

bugs.error_message: npx tsc --noEmit failed with TS6053 missing .next/types files after architect validation
bugs.root_cause: The tracked incremental TypeScript build artifact retained stale references to generated .next/types files while validation/build steps regenerated .next.
bugs.fix: Deleted tsconfig.tsbuildinfo and added it to .gitignore so TypeScript recomputes incremental state instead of reading stale generated paths.

bugs.error_message: Security review found public feedback/reservation routes accepted oversized or malformed request bodies before parsing
bugs.root_cause: The refactored public POST routes parsed request bodies before enforcing content length, content type, FormData file rejection, field caps, and escaped HTML email fields.
bugs.fix: Added request body guards, content-type checks, reservation field length caps, FormData file rejection, safe production errors, and HTML escaping for feedback email fields.

bugs.error_message: Redesigned QR menu sticky header + category bar scrolled away instead of pinning
bugs.root_cause: The global #tst-app wrapper sets overflow:hidden (to stop horizontal bleed), which makes it a scroll container and breaks position:sticky for any descendant relative to the viewport.
bugs.fix: Added 'body.kiosk-mode #tst-app { overflow: visible !important; }' (kiosk-mode is exclusive to the /table + /masa QR menu) and wrapped the header + category bar in a single sticky .stickyTop container so they stack without magic top offsets.

bugs.error_message: Taste Wizard modal rendered with a transparent background (computed backgroundColor rgba(0,0,0,0)) after the QR menu redesign
bugs.root_cause: MasaTasteWizard keeps its own table.module.scss and reads legacy theme CSS variables (--paper, --accent, --accent-dark, --card-bg, --paper-edge) that used to be provided by the old .paper/.themeClassic root. The new .page root only defined --ink/--bg/--brand, so those vars resolved to nothing and var(--paper) backgrounds became transparent.
bugs.fix: Added the legacy theme variables to .page, mapped to the new clean palette (--paper:#fff, --accent:#9e241a, etc.), so the wizard inherits correct on-brand colours and visually matches the new menu.
